Cloud

Dịch Vụ Quản Lý Khóa

A centralized service or system that creates, stores, rotates, and manages cryptographic keys used for securing data at rest and in transit within cloud and enterprise environments.

Quick answer: A centralized service or system that creates, stores, rotates, and manages cryptographic keys used for securing data at rest and in transit within cloud and enterprise environments.
